v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Fílii Sion * exsúltent in Rege suo.
text.en: Let the children of Sion * be joyful in their king.

text.la: Quam magnificáta * sunt ópera tua, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, * how great are thy works!

text.la: Lætábitur iustus * in Dómino et sperábit in eo.
text.en: The just shall rejoice * in the Lord, and shall hope in him.

text.la: Osténde nobis, Dómine, * lucem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: Show us, O Lord, * the light of thy mercies.
Let every thing that hath breath * praise the Lord.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui suffert tentatiónem: quóniam cum probátus fúerit, accípiet corónam vitæ, quam repromísit Deus diligéntibus se.
text.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been proved, he shall receive a crown of life, which God hath promised to them that love him.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Qui odit * ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life * in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

text.la: Deus, qui nos beáti Eusébii Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis ánnua solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius; ut, cuius natalítia cólimus, de eiúsdem étiam protectióne gaudeámus.
text.en: O God, who year by year dost gladden us by the solemn feast day of thy Blessed Martyr and Bishop Eusebius, mercifully grant that we who keep his birthday, may ever feel the joyful effects of his protection.

text.la: Levábit Dóminus signum, in natiónibus, et congregábit dispérsos Israël.
text.en: The Lord shall lift up a standard unto the nations, and shall gather together the outcasts of Israel.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Excita, Dómine, corda nostra ad præparándas Unigéniti tui vias: ut, per eius advéntum, purificátis tibi méntibus servíre mereámur:
text.en: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to make ready the ways of thine Only-begotten Son, that by His coming our minds being purified, we may the more worthily give up ourselves to thy service: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
